certification.name: ITIL 4 Practitioner: Information Security Management
certification.description: Practice-level ITIL 4 certification on managing risks to the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information. Closed-book exam of 20 multiple-choice questions in 30 minutes with a 65% pass mark; accredited training or official eLearning is mandatory.
certification.currency_note: Cheapest bundle including the exam voucher (eLearning); the $222 exam-only bundle is for retakes
